summaries.Good news: Today's uplifting stories celebrate human courage and community care: from Maasai warriors redefining bravery as lion protectors to a teenage roper rescuing a drowning man, and churches restoring sight to thousands through coordinated surgical marathons.
summaries.Ideas: The day reveals tensions between innovation and society: AI is reshaping job markets and cybersecurity faster than institutions can respond, while breakthrough solutions like silver diamine fluoride offer simple alternatives to invasive medical procedures.
summaries.Technology: Hardware innovation accelerates across robotics, drones, and thermal engineering, though geopolitical barriers now limit access to cutting-edge devices as the US restricts Chinese robots while companies race to build 'agentic AI' systems.
summaries.Design: From floating pools that clean contaminated rivers to stadiums designed for material efficiency and interiors supporting neurodivergent children, today's design work tackles urgent social and environmental challenges through thoughtful material and spatial innovation.

items.title: How an overlooked geothermal plant got a second chance
items.snippet: In June 2024, a small company called Zanskar purchased a geothermal power plant in New Mexico that was failing fast. The water coming from the underground reservoir was getting colder by the day, making the plant uneconomical to run. Now, two years later, that plant is running at full capacity again
items.line: A geothermal plant brought back to full productivity after failing demonstrates how innovation and persistence can revive seemingly dead infrastructure assets.
